# Byome

> Byome (byome.xyz) is a free community for honest beauty reviews, written by the people actually using the products. Members review makeup, skincare, hair care, fragrance, body care and nail products, chat in the Community, and grow a shelf of hand-drawn plants as they take part.

## What makes Byome different

- Reviews are rated from 1 to 5 leaves, and are rewarded for being detailed and thoughtful, whether they're positive or negative.
- Reviewers tick "Gifted" when a brand gave them the product, paid them, or they're connected to the brand, and the review shows a "Gifted" tag.
- Brands and advertisers have no say over what members write or which reviews are shown. Ads only appear in the Byome Shop, never on reviews or in the Community.
- Byome is for adults (18+) because members talk openly about grown-up skin concerns like fine lines, aging, retinol and pores, and those conversations shouldn't reach kids who are far too young to worry about them. Byome has no mature content, and won't have any.
- Byome is moderated by people, with an automod, and members can't post links to other websites.
- The plants, pots and shelves on Byome are drawn by hand by its founder. No AI art.
- Byome is free to join and use.

## Key pages

- [About Byome](https://byome.xyz/about.html): why Byome exists and how it keeps reviews honest
- [Frequently asked questions](https://byome.xyz/faq.html): joining, reviews and ratings, gifted products, Byome points, plant shelves, levels, events, posting rules and accounts
- [All products](https://byome.xyz/p/index.html): every product on Byome, by brand, each with its own page of reviews (updated nightly)
- [Reviews](https://byome.xyz/reviews.html): browse and search all reviews
- [Events](https://byome.xyz/events.html): seasonal events
- [Terms of use](https://byome.xyz/terms.html) and [Privacy policy](https://byome.xyz/privacy.html)

## Things Byome does not have

Byome has no XP, no login rewards page and no blueprints. Members earn Byome points for taking part (reviews, approved product suggestions, inviting friends, spotting bugs and typos) and spend them in the Byome Shop on pots, plants, shelves and profile backgrounds called biomes. There's a daily surprise (pick a seed packet once a day), member levels (Seed, Sprout, Sapling, Bloom, Evergreen) and seasonal events with achievements.
